title: cicerbita crambifolia
intro: Cicerbita crambifolia, commonly known as Compositae or a species of dandelion, is a type of flowering plant. The plant is said to offer various health benefits, including being used to treat gastrointestinal issues and fever, due to its diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties. Therapeutically, Cicerbita crambifolia is believed to have astringent, demulcent, and antiseptic actions, which contribute to its healing effects. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
